versions.changelog:
- Initial release of contractor-quote-duel skill.
- Compares 2–4 contractor quotes for the same home project using a unified scope-bidder matrix.
- Highlights scope gaps, flags unit price outliers, and assesses deposit/payment risk.
- Checks documentation completeness per trade.
- Generates tailored clarification emails for each bidder to address gaps and confirm details.
- Helps homeowners make informed, apples-to-apples bid comparisons and avoid common pitfalls.
